name: @carbon/api
description: Native ports for carbon-mini apps. Subpath modules — window, store, secrets, event, app, path, opener, os, process, autostart, updater, invoke, fs — each a thin TS wrapper over the engine's __cm_* host imports. PTY moved to the terminal plugin (carbon:terminal) — not always-on anymore, see products/carbon-sdk/terminal.
//exports: Subpaths are the public API and do not move when files do. An app writes @carbon/api/fs; which folder fs.ts sits in is this package's business.
